## Live Preview 
 -Requires version 1.1.6 beta1 or later; otherwise, the app will crash
 - Open an `.html` file,  then open the **Live Preview** panel and tap `File` 
 - Your project folder is served in a WebView, so relative CSS/JS/images/modules work 
 - `Auto` reloads the page when you save a file, `Log` shows console output, JS errors and missing files (404)
